articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE: UNP) has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.34 per share on the company’s common stock, payable June 30, 2025, to shareholders of record May 30, 2025.
articles.title: Union Pacific Corporation Declares Second Quarter 2025 Dividend

articles.summary: Union Pacific Railroad announced today its legendary steam locomotive, Big Boy No. 4014, will make two whistle-stops in Greeley, Colorado, this summer as part of a limited summer excursion.
articles.title: Union Pacific's Big Boy 4014 Will Make Two Whistle-Stops in Colorado During Limited 2025 Excursion

articles.summary: Union Pacific Railroad President Beth Whited will transition from her role as the railroad’s first female president to become a strategic advisor effective July 1, 2025. Whited will remain an advisor through early 2026.
articles.title: Union Pacific President Beth Whited Celebrates 37 Years with the Railroad and Announces Transition to Company Advisor
